verses.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.sm: Ona tali mai ai lea o Pilitati le Sua, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: How long wilt thou speak these things? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?
verses.sm: E te tautala i na upu seia afea? e fai foi ma matagi tetele o upu a lou fofoga seia afea?

verses.en: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?
verses.sm: Pe faapiopioina ea e le Atua le faamasinoga? pe faapiopioina ea mea tonu e Le e ona le malosi uma lava?

verses.en: If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;
verses.sm: Afai na agasala atu lau fanau ia te ia, ma ua lafoaiina i latou e ia i a latou solitulafono?

verses.en: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;
verses.sm: Afai e te matua saili atu i le Atua, ma aioi atu i Le e ona le malosi uma lava;

verses.en: If thou wert pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.
verses.sm: afai ua e lelei ma e amio saʻo, e maleifua mai lava nei o ia ona o oe, e faasaogalemu foi e ia le fale e fai ai lau amiotonu.

verses.en: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
verses.sm: E ui lava ina itiiti lou amataga, a e matua faateleina lou juga.

verses.en: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:
verses.sm: Auā ina e fesili atu ia i le tupulaga na muamua, ma ia e matua suesue i o latou matua.

verses.en: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)
verses.sm: Aua o i tatou O tagata ananafi, ua tatou le iloa; aua o tatou aso i le lalolagi o le ata ia.

verses.en: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?
verses.sm: Latou te le aʻoaʻo mai ea ia te oe, ma tau mai ia te oe, ma fai mai upu ai o latou loto?

verses.en: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
verses.sm: Pe tupu mai ea le kome a e le o i ai se palapala? pe tupu mai ea le utuutu a e le o i ai se vai?

verses.en: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.
verses.sm: A o lauolaola, ma le le salaina, e muamua ona mamae i vao iti uma.

verses.en: So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite's hope shall perish:
verses.sm: E faapea lava ala o i latou uma o e faagalogalo i le Atua; e faaumatia foi le faamoemoe o le tagata faalemata‘u.

verses.en: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider's web.
verses.sm: E vavaeeseina lona faamoemoe, o lona faatuatuaga foi o le fale o le apogaleveleve lea.

verses.en: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
verses.sm: E faalagolago o ia i lona fale, a e le mau; e taofimauina ai e ia, a e le tumau.

verses.en: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
verses.sm: Ua tupu olaola o ia, a O le laina, ua tupu foi ona tatupu i lana faatoaga.

verses.en: His roots are wrapped about the heap, and seeth the place of stones.
verses.sm: Ua -feujuiai ona aa i le faaputugamaa, ua iloa foi le mea o i ai maa.

verses.en: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.
verses.sm: E faaumatia lava o ia ai le mea o i ai o ia, ona faafiti ai lea ia te ia, e faapea atu, Ou te le iloa oe.

verses.en: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le olioli lea i lona ala, e tutupu foi nisi mai le eleele.

verses.en: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:
verses.sm: Faauta, e le lafoaiina e le Atua le ua sao lana amio, na te le taofia ae foi lima o e amio leaga.

verses.en: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.
verses.sm: Seia faatumuina e ia lou 1OPU 8,9 fofoga i le ata‘ata, ma ou laufofoga i le alaga fiafia.

verses.en: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.
verses.sm: E faaofuina i le má o e ua ʻinoʻino mai ia te oe, o le fale ie o e amio leaga, e leai lea. O le tali a Iopu ia
